title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 9.15 My Father's Health Lesson
vocab:
urging: 재촉하는, 성가신
over and over again: 반복해서
kick the habit: 나쁜 습관을 버리다
withdrawal: 철회, 취소, 회수, 금단
cough: 기침
phlegm: 가래
pass away: 별세하다
cold turkey: 갑자기 끊다
get cravings: 땡기다
sentences:
I finally kicked the habit.
My cough and phlegm were gone.
I quit cold turkey back then.
I still get cravings once in a while.
